This is the repeat application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.
His earlier application (M.Cr.C.No.9192/23) was dismissed as withdrawn by this Court on 12.04.2023.

T he applicant is in custody since 08.12.2022 in connection with FIR No.728/2022 (date not mentioned) registered at Police Station Kotwali, District- Umaria, for the offence punishable under Sections 363,366,344,376 and 506 of IPC and Section 3 read with Section 4 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

sentences.text: The prosecutrix was recovered after 38 days from the possession of the present applicant.
Statement of prosecutrix was recorded wherein she has made allegation against the present applicant.
The FSL report has also come positive.
However, the prosecutrix has turned hostile and retracted her earlier statement and has not made any allegation against the present applicant in her Court statement.
The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that there was love affair between the prosecutrix and the applicant.
The prosecutrix is 17 years and 6 months old and the applicant is only about 20 years of age.
It is stated that the prosecutrix herself went with the applicant, but under the pressure of her parents, she has lodged false complaint against the present applicant.
Learned
PL has opposed the bail application.

However, considering that the prosecutrix was 17 years and 6 months old at the time of incident and has not stated anything against the present applicant in her Court statement, and looking to the custody period of the applicant, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
In case, if the applicant is found involved in any other offence during the pendency of the trial or during the bail period, or if any attempt is made by him to influence or threaten the witnesses,
directly or indirectly, shall entail cancellation of this bail order.
He shall also appear before the trial Court on each and every date of hearing and no adjournment shall be sought on his behalf.
If the applicant is found involved in prolonging the trial, this bail order will stand cancelled automatically.
Certified copy as per rules.
